title: unify-terraform-private-state-layout-add-gpu-node-pools-iam-networking-modules
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: Unify and simplify how state is laid out for Private deployments and introduce dedicated Terraform modules for GPU node pools, IAM roles, and networking. This consolidates several repo-specific state layouts we used across cloud providers into a single opinionated layout that makes upgrades, imports, and multi-environment management more predictable. This PR contains three focused modules (modules/gpu_node_pool, modules/iam, modules/network) plus a migration guide and test harness changes. Key goals: 1) avoid duplicate TF state where possible, 2) provide a sharable, reusable module surface for GPU node pools with autoscaling and preemptible/burst options, 3) centralize IAM role/policy generation to reduce drift, 4) expose network topology primitives used by Private installer (VPCs, subnets, route tables, peering), 5) provide an in-place migration path for existing customers to move to the unified state layout. Checklist: - [x] add modules/gpu_node_pool with examples and documentation - [x] add modules/iam consolidating roles used by private control plane and node bootstrap - [x] add modules/network with VPC/subnet templates and cross-region peering helper - [x] update examples/private-deploy to reference new modules - [x] add state_layout_migration.md with step-by-step import and validation commands - [x] add acceptance tests and terraform plan CI - [x] run internal migration on staging clusters and validate rollout - [x] add backwards-compatible variables and toggles for legacy layouts Notes: The change is intentionally conservative in resource naming to avoid force-replacements during import. The migration doc contains explicit import commands that map old state keys to the new module addresses. There is one breaking surface for customers who rely on a custom state key pattern; for those customers we provide a compatibility flag (legacy_state_layout = true) and documentation on remaining on the old layout. See linked linear items ENG-7842 and ENG-7890 for rollout schedule and follow-ups.

Aisha Patel: Thanks Diego, added explanation to variables.tf and moved lifecycle.prevent_destroy into a toggle (prevent_destroy = var.prevent_destroy) so teams can opt-in.
Sofia Ivanov: IAM module looks much cleaner. Please ensure policy ARNs are conditionally created for on-prem vs cloud (added suggested patch).
Aisha Patel: Addressed, policy creation is gated by var.cloud_provider and documented in the migration guide.
Liam O'Connor: CI plan showed a terraform plan failure on initial run because provider version constraints were too strict. Recommend widening to allow 4.x series.
Aisha Patel: Widened provider constraint and re-ran CI; plan passed on second run.
release_notes: Introduces unified Terraform modules for Private deployments: GPU node pools, IAM roles, and networking. Provides a documented migration path for existing state layouts. Administrators should follow examples/private-deploy/state_layout_migration.md to migrate existing state. Backwards-compatibility flag 'legacy_state_layout' is available to delay migration.
